title: Oil Trades Near $107 as Houthi-Saudi Fighting Escalates
description:
Brent oil traded near $107 barrel as fighting between Yemen-based Houthi militants and Saudi-backed forces intensified. The global benchmark surged more than 6% in the previous session and is on track for its biggest weekly gain since July. Bloomberg's Ben Sharples reports.
